description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git restore' command within a git repository. It sets up various test cases to verify the functionality and handling of different options of the restore command, including scenarios with file restoration from different refs, handling of index changes, merge conflicts, and incompatible options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after test completion for cleanup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Signals completion of the test script.

search-terms: restore a file on worktree from another ref
restore a file in the index from another ref
